name: com.nekoandreeva.nekoscriptgraph
description: Scratch-like visual programming for Unity that never puts anything into your code. NSG writes a block config next to a script to make it editable as blocks, and translates both ways. 7 languages (C, C++, C#, HLSL, Java, Rust, Python), 15 locales with full Arabic/Hebrew RTL, and an in-editor MCP server for agent-assisted editing.
